review_method: All rendered slide contact sheets, source-figure sheets, cropped panels, recording posters, and selected full-size slides inspected. Changed panels and revised prose re-rendered and checked.
checks: Title image left/instructor details right; descriptive title and course identity
Three explanatory paragraphs per teaching slide, matched to notes; all final paragraphs reviewed
Black body/caption/footer text and Arial; white backgrounds and restrained rosewood headings
Relevant original images, intact selected panels, source labels/axes/scale context
Source movie and figure retained together with static posters and readable credits
Evenly distributed recordings through the final content quarter
Source models and anatomy distinguished from recordings of neural activity
USC observational training results distinguished from generalized causal benefits
